cases.kind: UI-only scale controls; event branch separately gated
cases.setup: On an independent reset with independently admitted no-loaded-tuning and known current-clip root/scale, inspect Chord title controls.
cases.action: Actually enable Chord Use Current Scale; select an admitted degree-valued Shift control. Record the offered unit/control and clip ownership. For an event branch independently establish productive qualifying notes first; do not use a tuning-disabled control as a negative pass.
cases.source_claim: Source names title Use Current Scale and degree-valued pitch controls; no degree or quantization equation.

cases.kind: UI-only scale control; event branch separately gated
cases.setup: Independent known clip scale/root and admitted Random controls, no loaded tuning that disables this control.
cases.action: Actually enable Random Use Current Scale and operate an independently admitted Interval control in its offered unit. A future constrained-pitch branch requires NONEMPTY qualifying altered output; no off-scale passthrough, nearest-note or degree-spacing law.
cases.source_claim: Source constrains generated pitches to the clip scale; unsupported unit/interval/dry-note semantics stay U.

cases.kind: UI-only style entry and separately guarded pattern
cases.setup: Admitted Arpeggiator UI; independent reset before each style entry.
cases.action: Use the Style chooser and display Previous/Next buttons to reach admitted styles. Inspect the displayed pattern; on a separately productive note path exercise Random continuous style. Do not infer an exact random sequence from the display.
cases.source_claim: Style chooser/display/Previous and Next roles and continuous Random role only.

cases.setup: Known qualifying chord with independently received distinct notes; genuinely NONEMPTY complete productive pattern on each independent reset.
cases.action: Select Random Other and retain a complete observed traversal before inspecting any claimed no-repeat subset. Separately select Random Once, retain a complete productive pattern with unchanged input, then deliberately change the input chord. Do not require the changed-input realization to differ from the prior one.
cases.source_claim: Other and Once documented roles; finite observations do not prove liveness, distribution or always-different outcomes.

cases.kind: UI-only rate modes; event branch gated
cases.setup: Admitted independent Free and Sync mode contexts.
cases.action: Actually toggle Free and Sync and set an accepted displayed Rate in each unit. Retain old NME-008 nominal relation unchanged; any new pulse/timing comparison is null, even after genuine productive pattern output.
cases.source_claim: Rate milliseconds versus tempo-synced divisions; no timing tolerance or clock implementation.

cases.setup: Admitted Distance/Steps/Root/Scale controls and known local/clip-scale ownership on separate resets.
cases.action: Actually select an accepted negative Distance and positive Steps, operate local Root/Scale choosers, then in a separately admitted Use Current Scale context operate the degree-valued control. Future direction/output inspection requires productive matched transposition first.
cases.source_claim: Signed Distance and local-versus-current scale roles; no generalized stride/degree formula.

cases.setup: Genuinely productive NONEMPTY held pattern; at least one original physical key remains held throughout additions/toggles; distinct received identities established.
cases.action: Enable Hold; while the original key is still physically held, add an independently received new key, then press an included note again to inspect toggle-out. Keep all-keys-up replacement/addition in old NME-014 U; do not reuse this physical-held history to decide it.
cases.source_claim: Documented held-key addition/toggle context separated from unresolved all-keys-up replacement.

cases.setup: Independent productive chord/pattern reset for each admitted Retrigger mode, with output observed before any restart/termination branch.
cases.action: Actually select Off, Note and Beat Retrigger contexts, set an accepted Beat Interval, and on separate resets set finite Repeats 1 and 2. Record LED/control roles and finite histories; no indefinite-playback proof, retrigger scheduler or note-retirement oracle.
cases.source_claim: Retrigger options, LED and finite Repeats roles, documentary default not a factory/reset guarantee.

cases.kind: UI-only groove entry; event branch gated
cases.setup: Known available Groove chooser and independently admitted Global Amount controls.
cases.action: Choose a groove, operate its admitted Global Amount entry in the Groove Pool and separately the Control Bar. Any output comparison requires productive matched nonzero groove baseline; no swing, timing, coefficient or shared-owner numerical law.
cases.source_claim: Groove selection and two Global Amount entry contexts only.

cases.setup: Admitted velocity controls and, for event branches, independently recognized nonzero velocities and productive pattern before shape changes.
cases.action: Enable Velocity, change Target and accepted Decay, then enable the velocity Retrigger switch and trigger an admitted pattern retrigger on an independent reset. Record actual control entry/history without decay formula, silent-note or timing oracle.
cases.source_claim: Velocity toggle/Target/Decay and velocity-retrigger roles only.

cases.setup: Admitted Mod Wheel and Custom A controls. UI-only assignment does not need hardware; transmission branch needs independently admitted receiving path and known qualifying CC reception.
cases.action: Actually operate Mod Wheel. On a separate reset select a non-default admitted Custom A CC Type alternative and turn A on and off. Do not infer payload encoding, target response magnitude or every CC type from a displayed chooser.
cases.source_claim: Mod Wheel and customizable A toggle/CC Type roles only.

cases.setup: Independently admitted actual CC Type chooser and rename entrypoint, not an invented generic gesture.
cases.action: For each B–M control on independent reset use its CC Type Chooser to select an admitted message and actually rename the control through the independently established entrypoint. Retain original bank-switch and preset cases; Push label transport and unknown rename gesture stay U.
cases.source_claim: B–M individual assignment/rename roles; no protocol, preset or naming grammar.

cases.setup: Known distinct eligible incoming CC identities and independently productive receiving path before Send/Learn event inspection.
cases.action: Actually click Send after assigning admitted controls. Separately enable Learn for an admitted customizable control and deliver a separately identifiable incoming CC; inspect assignment. A flag, name or meter alone does not establish message delivery or a successful learning outcome.
cases.source_claim: Send current values and incoming-source Learn roles; no count, ordering, codec or channel oracle.

cases.kind: two independently productive sources before merge
cases.setup: Establish an independently received automation CC stream and an independently received CC Control dial stream for the SAME admitted CC message on separate matched resets; BOTH genuinely NONEMPTY with distinguishable source histories.
cases.action: Only after both independent positives, combine CC automation and the CC Control dial on the admitted route. Inspect the joint history as a future proposal; do not grade missing streams, event order, counts, merge algebra or hardware delivery.
cases.source_claim: Source says existing same-message CC automation merges with CC Control; protocol/merge law remains U.

cases.setup: Independently admitted Shift slots and qualifying root with genuine root and generated-note reception before LED association.
cases.action: Set +4 and +7 in two different Shift slots, actually exchange the slots, and observe each corresponding Shift LED alongside the independently received generated identity. Do not use LED activity itself to prove note delivery.
cases.source_claim: Any slot ordering and per-Shift LED named roles; retained old triad predicate unchanged.

cases.setup: Independently establish distinct productive Shift assignments on separate resets with actual generated identities before inspecting loss.
cases.action: Set one slot to +8, establish its output, and independently establish the second slot with a distinct admitted Shift value. Only then reassign the second to +8 and inspect duplicate-assignment deactivation. Do not generalize to collisions with other incoming notes, zero-shift or note-off ownership.
cases.source_claim: Same-pitch Shift duplication deactivates additional assignment; no note-lifecycle expansion.

cases.setup: Independently admitted per-Shift controls; actual nonzero incoming and generated-note velocities. Chance branch first demonstrates a productive generated note at Chance 100 on the matched source.
cases.action: Actually enable Velocity and change each admitted per-Shift slider, then separately enable Chance and change its slider. After the matched productive Chance 100 baseline inspect Chance 0 suppression. Keep old finite 100%-velocity/Chance predicates, no intermediate frequency or formula.
cases.source_claim: Velocity/Chance toggle and per-Shift slider roles; no probability calibration or numeric transfer.

cases.setup: Known nonzero admitted Strum and genuinely productive root/generated notes, independently identified before duplicate/loss comparison.
cases.action: Actually open Chord title context menu and enable Play Duplicate Notes When Strumming on a separate matched reset with a duplicated strum context. No non-Strum inference, timing/count/scheduler or simultaneous-order oracle.
cases.source_claim: Context option is specifically duplicate notes when strumming, not a universal duplication law.

cases.setup: Productive matched nonzero Strum before shaping; separately reset between accepted positive and negative values.
cases.action: Actually operate positive and negative Tension and Crescendo in separate admitted contexts while preserving the original productive path. Inspect future signed-shaping history, without ramp/duration/velocity/timing formula or mandatory nonidentity for every input.
cases.source_claim: Tension and Crescendo signed shape roles only.

cases.kind: genuine per-note input and generated output
cases.setup: Independently recognized qualifying MPE/per-note input and BOTH productive root/generated note identities; nonzero relevant expression established before disabling, not just a device flag.
cases.action: Actually enable Send Per Note Events to Generated Notes in the title context menu; establish the matched productive expression path, then disable on a separate matched reset before future absence inspection. No channel/voice allocation, codec, inheritance or forwarding assumption.
cases.source_claim: Named per-note option and source role; no new per-note routing law.

cases.setup: Admitted controls, Latch explicitly OFF. For event branches independently identify incoming Note On and Note Off and genuinely productive output separately, without forcing a guessed same-key pairing.
cases.action: On independent resets actually toggle Trigger Source Note On/Note Off and Free/Sync Time Mode, select accepted Length in each offered unit and admitted Gate. Record four control contexts; old finite nominal cases remain unchanged, new onset/duration comparisons null.
cases.source_claim: Trigger Source and Time Mode roles; no new note-off pairing, scheduling or synced duration formula.

cases.setup: Latch explicitly OFF and Trigger Source Note Off, independently admitted controls and identified qualifying release events with productive output.
cases.action: Actually change Release Velocity and Decay, and separately an accepted negative Key Scale value. Re-establish productive matched input/output per reset. Do not settle Note Off Latch/pedal transition or new release/duration/velocity equation.
cases.source_claim: Note Off release dynamics controls and signed Key Scale roles only.

cases.setup: Latch OFF first; establish Length/Gate and Note Off dynamics are genuinely enabled and operable in their admitted source contexts. Event branch requires productive output, UI-only disable check needs no hardware.
cases.action: Actually enable Latch separately for Note On and Note Off source contexts, then inspect offered control enablement against that prior enabled baseline. Keep NME-NL-L01/L05 Latch OFF and Note Off all-keys/pedal ambiguity unresolved; no emitted-note lifetime oracle.
cases.source_claim: Latch disables applicable controls; enabled-control baseline separate from unknown release-latch scheduling.

cases.setup: Independent admitted semitone and degree contexts; known clip scale and no tuning unavailability; accepted displayed endpoints, no inferred integer encoding.
cases.action: Actually operate Pitch at an independently accepted endpoint in each offered unit and use Step Up/Down with an admitted degree Step Width. Do not infer overflow, Range units, clamping or a new endpoint-output law.
cases.source_claim: Pitch and degree Step Width named UI roles; old finite semitone-step case preserved.

cases.kind: range mode entry and upper boundary
cases.setup: Independently established admitted Lowest/positive Range and independently known upper boundary, whose unit/end inclusion is NOT inferred from Range label. BOTH distinct qualifying input identities and productive received output established before absence.
cases.action: Actually choose Block, Fold and Limit on independent resets. For upper-side Limit prepare a note independently known outside the upper side and inspect a future history; retain old lower-side tests and null Fold output, never compute the unknown upper endpoint from Range.
cases.source_claim: Three Mode chooser roles and upper-side context; source unit/endpoint/Fold outcomes remain U.

cases.setup: Admitted Random controls and genuine productive NONEMPTY altered output before direction, unchanged or LED comparisons; no promise of alteration in a fixed number of trials.
cases.action: Actually select admitted Choices up to source-offered 24 and Sign Add/Sub/Bi on independent resets. Observe LEDs only alongside independently identified higher/lower/unchanged outcomes as they actually occur; do not demand all directions or a finite frequency. Alt ambiguity NME-049–051 remains unchanged U.
cases.source_claim: Choices/sign and LED roles; finite old support sets only, no RNG/distribution/liveness law.

cases.setup: Admitted Base/Scale Name/User controls; independent genuine C-to-D output before deleting its assignment; independently received inside/outside notes before range/no-output comparison.
cases.action: Actually select Base and Scale Name, then User. Move the highlighted assignment with the mouse to make the retained C-to-D context, demonstrate productive D output, then delete with a mouse click. Retain old exact Fold/range examples and +/-6 U; no 13th-class, selection geometry or reset-default law.
cases.source_claim: Chooser/User/mouse move/mouse-click deletion roles; productive history qualifies old deletion/selected-range branches.

cases.setup: Independently identified valid NONZERO Note On and Note Off velocity inputs with BOTH separately productive qualifying output contexts; no raw Note On velocity-zero baseline or guessed off pairing.
cases.action: Actually choose Note On, Note Off (Rel. Vel.) and Both on independent resets. Operate accepted Lowest/Range and Out Low/High controls and inspect curve X/Y roles. No new transfer, sample, event-ownership or mixed-stream numeric oracle.
cases.source_claim: Operation and displayed input/output curve-axis roles only.

cases.setup: Known valid nonzero out-of-range input and independently admitted input/output interval; genuine productive matched Clip output before Gate suppression, plus independently received eligible in-range positive.
cases.action: Actually select Clip with that valid nonzero input, establish productive output, then select Gate on a matched reset and inspect future suppression/LED context. Preserve old Fixed/Gate finite laws and NME-066 raw-zero U; do not derive endpoint or note-off-retirement laws.
cases.source_claim: Clip versus Gate named roles with genuine valid nonzero positive, not raw-zero ambiguity.

cases.kind: random display and signed curve histories
cases.setup: Admitted controls and genuinely productive nonzero velocity path before event-effect comparison. UI shading inspection alone needs no hardware; positive Random separately established.
cases.action: Actually set positive Random and inspect gray shading; on independent resets operate positive/negative Compand and then combined Drive/Compand. Retain NME-064 only 60..127 membership and NME-065 arithmetic U; no displaced baseline, gray-pixel, distribution or transfer formula.
cases.source_claim: Positive Random shading and signed Compand/combined-control roles only.
